definitions.explanation: A bird that has hatched but has not yet reached adulthood. Used in birdwatching, nature writing, and zoology to distinguish immature birds, which often have different plumage from adults.

examples.english: There was a young bird in the nest.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{幼鳥|ようちょう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦まだ→まだ：00603_mada⟧⟦{飛|と}ぶ→飛ぶ：00759_tobu⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できない→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: This young bird still cannot fly.

examples.japanese: {幼鳥|ようちょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{羽|はね}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{色|いろ}→色：00849_iro⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{成鳥|せいちょう}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大|おお}きく→大きい：00335_ookii⟧⟦{異|こと}なる→異なる：02101_kotonaru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、⟦{種類|しゅるい}→種類：01560_shurui⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{判別|はんべつ}→判別：15349_hanbetsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{難|むずか}しい→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Because the feather color of young birds differs greatly from adults, it can be difficult to identify the species.

notes:
Composed of {幼|よう} (young, immature) and {鳥|ちょう} (bird). A straightforward compound used in nature observation and ornithology. The word pairs naturally with {成鳥|せいちょう} (adult bird) when discussing the stages of a bird's development.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {幼鳥|ようちょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{育|そだ}てる→育てる：01235_sodateru⟧: to raise a young bird
- {幼鳥|ようちょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{羽|はね}: feathers of a young bird
- {幼鳥|ようちょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{巣立|すだ}つ→巣立つ：27798_sudatsu⟧: a young bird leaves the nest

RELATED WORDS:
- {成鳥|せいちょう}: adult bird — the mature counterpart
- ひな: chick; hatchling — a newly hatched bird, younger stage than {幼鳥|ようちょう}
- ⟦{雛鳥|ひなどり}→雛鳥：24779_hinadori⟧: baby bird — similar to ひな, emphasizing the very young stage
- ⟦{野鳥|やちょう}→野鳥：14497_yachou⟧: wild bird — commonly used in birdwatching contexts
